summary: Stage/StageTransition/StageEntry models in a new `stages` app. Acyclicity enforced in StageTransition.clean() via BFS from the target stage (rejects direct and indirect cycles), plus same-event and no-self-loop checks. StageEntry enforces the participation boundary via a partial unique constraint (subject_type/subject_id, exited_at IS NULL) — one active stage per subject, re-entry allowed after exit. subject_type/subject_id use AuditEvent's existing lightweight-reference convention since teams/projects (C-B07/C-B08) don't exist yet.

verification.result: passed; 11 tests (unique name, self-loop, cross-event, direct cycle, indirect 4-hop cycle, branch, merge, duplicate edge, participation boundary + re-entry, multiple subjects)
